function.name: list_dir
function.description: List files and directories under a path. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

path.description: Relative or absolute path within the workspace.

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth when recursive is true.

show_hidden.description: Whether to include dotfiles and dot-directories.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file with line numbers and pagination. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the file within the workspace.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

respect_gitignore.description: Whether to refuse reading paths ignored by .gitignore.

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files by glob pattern under a directory. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

glob_pattern.description: Glob pattern such as **/*.tsx or src/**/*.rs.

target_directory.description: Directory to search from. Defaults to the workspace root.

head_limit.description: Maximum number of matching paths to return.

respect_gitignore.description: Whether to skip paths ignored by .gitignore.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regex pattern. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for.

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the workspace root.

glob.description: Optional glob filter to limit searched files, such as *.{ts,tsx}.

output_mode.description: One of content, files_with_matches, or count.

case_insensitive.description: Whether to ignore letter case while matching.

context_before.description: Number of lines to include before each match.

context_after.description: Number of lines to include after each match.

context.description: Number of lines to include before and after each match.

head_limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Number of results to skip in content mode.

respect_gitignore.description: Whether to skip paths ignored by .gitignore.

function.name: list_shells
function.description: List background shell processes started by the agent. Returns running shells by default; use status_filter to inspect other states when needed.

status_filter.description: Filter by status. Default "running". Use "all" to include completed and failed shells.

task_id_filter.description: Optional task ID to list only shells from a specific agent run.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for real-time information outside training data, such as news, version numbers, or current events. Include version numbers or dates in technical queries when relevant.

search_term.description: The search term to look up on the web. Be specific and include relevant keywords.

explanation.description: One sentence explanation of why this search is being used.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

function.name: browse_page
function.description: Fetch a public web page and return readable Markdown content. Use after web_search when you need the full page text. Results are paginated like read_file: use start_line (1-based) and max_lines to page through the content. Does not render JavaScript-heavy pages. Do not call repeatedly for the same URL.

url.description: The URL to fetch. Must be http or https.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

explanation.description: One sentence explanation of why this page is being fetched.

function.name: list_skills
function.description: List enabled user skills (slug, name, description). User skills must be enabled by the user before they appear. Use before read_skill when you need specialized workflow instructions.

function.name: read_skill
function.description: Load the full instructions for an enabled skill by slug. Returns an error if the skill is missing or not enabled.

function.name: todo_read
function.description: Read the current structured todo list for this chat session. Use when you need to inspect or re-sync task state before deciding what to update with todo_write.

function.name: get_workspace_tree
function.description: Display the workspace directory tree structure with depth recursion. Respects .gitignore and automatically excludes large directories (node_modules, .git, dist, etc.). Scans from the workspace root — no path required. Results are paginated like read_file: use start_line (1-based) and max_lines to page through the tree.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return.
